data.text: Transforming network feasibility analysis from tribal knowledge into a repeatable decision engine.
A reusable decision-support solution that replaced manual dependency on domain experts with a structured, scalable workflow for evaluating network feasibility.

data.title: From expert bottleneck to a repeatable decision engine.
data.subtitle: We transformed a specialist-dependent, manual feasibility process into an automated toolkit that delivers fast, consistent, and auditable results.

pillars.label: Challenge
pillars.title: Feasibility lived as tribal knowledge.
pillars.body: Critical network decisions were bottlenecked by specialist availability. Assumptions varied by person, documentation was thin, and repeating an analysis meant rebuilding context from scratch.

points.text: Expert-dependent reviews created multi-day turnaround times
Inconsistent criteria made outcomes hard to compare
No durable workflow for non-specialists to run first-pass assessments

pillars.label: Solution
pillars.title: A structured workflow, automated for scale.
pillars.body: We codified expert judgment into an Excel-first toolkit with Office Scripts automation—making the process transparent, repeatable, and easy to use across the team.

pillars.label: Impact
pillars.title: Faster decisions. Stronger outcomes.
pillars.body: The toolkit removed the expert bottleneck and enabled teams to evaluate more scenarios, faster—with consistency and confidence.

data.title: From informal judgment to a structured workflow.
data.intro: We translated domain expertise into a transparent decision model, then automated the repetitive layers so analysts could focus on interpretation instead of reconstruction.

steps.title: Map the decision logic
steps.body: Worked with domain experts to capture feasibility criteria, dependencies, and exception paths in a form that could be reviewed and tested.

steps.title: Build the Excel decision surface
steps.body: Designed a familiar spreadsheet interface for inputs, scenario comparison, and clear output states — without forcing users into a new platform.

steps.title: Automate with Office Scripts
steps.body: Encoded repeatable calculations and validation checks so the same evaluation path could run consistently in minutes.

steps.title: Validate with synthetic recreation
steps.body: Recreated representative scenarios to prove the toolkit matched expert outcomes before rolling it into day-to-day use.

metrics.note: Criteria and assumptions live in the toolkit, not only in people's heads.

data.title: Need a decision system your team can run?
data.body: We help organizations turn expert-dependent processes into structured analytics and automation; starting with practical MVPs that create immediate operating leverage.
